messages:
Aaron K: Quick follow-up from the cost attribution RFC — major ask: can we land a low-cardinality 'billing_resource' at ingestion time, but avoid spamming span/metric cardinality? Thoughts.
Maya S: Agree on a single resource id per request. Concern: some customers have 10k+ resource_ids (orgs with 100s of teams + dev vs prod). That will explode metrics tags.
Sasha R: Two orthogonal options: (A) add resource_id only to trace root and do aggregation in query time; (B) enrich spans/metrics at ingest but only for a bounded sample or with hashed buckets. Tradeoffs:
- A: preserves low metric cardinality, but makes single-span cost breakdown harder and pushes load to query-time joins.
- B: easier for span-level attribution, but increases storage & index cardinality; needs quotas.
Elena P: From pipeline side, we can do an enrichment stage in vector/fluentd that maps host -> resource via lookup table. That lets us control rate and deduplicate. Also can emit a 'resource_lookup_version' tag for rollback.
Aaron K: Nice. What about sampled enrichment? e.g., enrich 5% of spans fully for detailed audits, and always attach resource_id to root span.
Maya S: 5% + root sounds reasonable. Also add a histogram metric for 'enriched_span_fraction' so we can detect drift.
Sasha R: Implementation sketch:
```json
{"ingest_transform": "resource_lookup", "mode": "sampled", "sample_rate": 0.05}
```
We should also provide a config to switch to 'always' for enterprise customers with Dedicated.
Infra-bot: telemetry-pipeline deploy succeeded: env=prod, version=2026-02-28-cc7
Elena P: Also recommend an ingestion rewrite rule to normalize resource ids (strip ephemeral suffixes) to reduce cardinality.
Aaron K: Good call. Action items:
- Elena: prototype vector lookup + sampling in staging by EOD Fri (assigned)
- Sasha: write short RFC addendum with metrics/query implications (due Mon)
- Maya: validate retention & cost model with finance for 10x cardinality delta (sync Wed)
Anyone object?
Maya S: no objections, +1
Sasha R: +1, will start the addendum
Elena P: on it
Aaron K: I'll update the rollout checklist and include a rollback toggle. Thanks all :thumbsup:
